hints: Focus on how skeletal formulas work, every corner and end of a line is a carbon, but N atoms are shown explicitly.
Count carefully around the three fused rings to find 12 carbons and 2 nitrogens, then work out hydrogens from valency of 4 for carbon.
Once you have the full molecular formula, simplify it to the smallest whole number ratio to get the empirical formula.
walkthrough:
**Decode the skeletal formula**

Remember, in skeletal formulas we do not draw C-H bonds. Each vertex is a carbon with enough hydrogens to make 4 bonds in total.

Rule: $\text{number of H on C} = 4 - (\text{number of bonds shown to C})$

**Count carbons and nitrogens**

The diagram has two outer benzene rings plus a central ring. Counting all vertices gives 12 carbons. The two N atoms in the middle are drawn explicitly.

So far: $C_{12}N_{2}$

**Count hydrogens**

Look at the outer edges. There are 8 $\text{CH}$ groups on the two side rings, each carbon has one H. The 4 carbons at the fusion points and the 2 nitrogens have no H.

Molecular formula: $\text{C}_{12}\text{H}_{8}\text{N}_{2}$

**Simplify to empirical formula**

Empirical means simplest whole number ratio. All subscripts 12, 8, 2 share a factor of 2.

$$\text{C}_{12}\text{H}_{8}\text{N}_{2} \div 2 \rightarrow \text{C}_{6}\text{H}_{4}\text{N}$$

options.A: Correct. The molecular formula is $\text{C}_{12}\text{H}_{8}\text{N}_{2}$, and dividing by 2 gives the simplest ratio $\text{C}_{6}\text{H}_{4}\text{N}$.
options.B: Incorrect. $\text{C}_{6}\text{H}_{6}\text{N}$ has too many hydrogens. This comes from assuming each outer carbon is like benzene ($\text{C}_{6}\text{H}_{6}$) and forgetting that fused carbons lose their H.
options.C: Incorrect. $\text{C}_{12}\text{H}_{8}\text{N}_{2}$ is the molecular formula, not the empirical formula. You must simplify to the lowest whole number ratio.
options.D: Incorrect. $\text{C}_{12}\text{H}_{12}\text{N}_{2}$ overcounts hydrogens and is not simplified. It assumes every carbon has a hydrogen, including the four junction carbons which have none.
